bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
service=gace-userbot-verify.service
state="$(systemctl --user is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ "$state" != active ]; then echo "USERBOT_SERVICE_INACTIVE"; exit 61; fi
if [ ! -f scripts/userbot_test_client.py ]; then echo "USERBOT_IPC_CLIENT_MISSING"; exit 62; fi
if ! grep -q '"topic_entry_audit"' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py; then echo "USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT_NOT_INSTALLED"; exit 63; fi
printf 'USERBOT_AUDIT_ROUTE=AVAILABLE\\n'
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py topic_entry_audit --chat-id=-1003847210571 --page 0
printf 'USERBOT_AUDIT_FIRST_PAGE_DONE\\n'
state="$(systemctl --user is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)"
test "$state" = active || exit 64
